svg.title: How a trace becomes a safe record
svg.desc: 1, Observe: Tool calls, files read, tests, costs, errors. Never hidden reasoning. 2, Scrub secrets: Passwords, API keys, and tokens are removed before anything is saved. 3, Cap and store: Each record is size-limited, then stored under its own fingerprint. 4, Note it: The Ledger gets a short receipt pointing at the stored record.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: From what an agent did to a safe record

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Secrets are removed first, then everything is stored and receipted.
